## TASK 3 — Read the webhook reliability figures

**Why:** a webhook fix shipped on 2026-09-10 (commit `224211a`): the age window was 24h, but
Shopify retries for ~48h carrying the *original* triggered-at, so valid retries were being
rejected. The window is now 7 days plus dedup by webhook id. The dashboard shows a **7-day trailing
window**, so the pre-fix failures age out on 15 Sep — meaning a reading taken from 16 Sep onward
contains only post-fix deliveries and is the one that settles it.

Two scheduled tasks were meant to do this automatically but **are not bound to this computer**
(see the owner checklist), so they fire into a browserless cloud session and produce nothing.
Do it by hand.

**Do:** Partner Dashboard → Navaal → Monitoring → Webhooks.

**Read verbatim:** overall failure rate and severity · per-topic rate **and delivery count** for
`app/uninstalled` and `shop/redact` · p90 response time · Removed-webhooks count · the per-day
ok/failed split for the whole visible range.

**The baseline to compare against** (2026-09-10, ~11:00 UTC): overall **75.0% High**;
`app/uninstalled` 68.182% of **22** @ 1,403 ms; `shop/redact` 100.0% of **9** @ 816 ms;
`app/scopes_update` 0% of **1** @ 534 ms; Removed webhooks **0**; daily Sep 8 = 1 ok / 18 failed,
Sep 9 = 2 ok / 5 failed, Sep 10 = 5 ok / 1 failed.

**The trap:** never report an improvement from the percentage alone. **An unchanged delivery COUNT
means nothing happened**, whatever the percentage says. State the count next to every rate.

**Done looks like:** the numbers, then a one-line verdict: post-fix deliveries occurred and
succeeded / occurred and failed / did not occur at all.
